##### Project general facts

Najd Four is conceived as a low-rise gated residential compound with a deliberately compact building height. The architectural identity focuses on low-density structural planning, creating open horizontal perspectives and integrating abundant natural light across the development. Modern facades with clean lines, shaded overhangs, and integrated greenery define the overall design concept.

The community features centralized wellness facilities, including an outdoor swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, and a dedicated children's play space. A central landscaped green promenade serves as the primary pedestrian thoroughfare, connecting different areas of the compound, while duplex residences enjoy rooftop terraces with open panoramic views.

Residential options comprise one-bedroom simplex apartments alongside one- and two-bedroom duplex units. Ground-floor residences incorporate private landscaped gardens, while duplex layouts include upper garden terraces and dedicated outdoor sitting areas. Living spaces are fitted with modern tiled bathrooms, integrated kitchen cabinetry, storage areas, master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and independent central air-conditioning systems.

##### Parking

Underground parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Rimal is a growing residential district in north-eastern Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, set close to the main arteries leading towards the northern growth corridor of the capital. The neighbourhood offers a calm, family-oriented setting with newer communities, wide streets and easy access to Al Thumama Road.

Key destinations within easy reach include King Khalid International Airport, King Abdulaziz Equestrian Field, Roshan Front, Princess Nora University and Naif College for National Security, along with the hotels serving the airport district. Schools, mosques, local shops and healthcare services support daily life across the surrounding neighbourhoods.

North-eastern Riyadh benefits from major infrastructure investment and the wider projects connected to Riyadh Expo, supporting long-term demand for modern homes. Al Rimal combines this growth outlook with direct access to the airport and key road corridors, positioning the area for steady residential interest from families and professionals.
